title: Meta Stock Falls 2.4% as AI Stocks Slide (Nov 16)
summary: Meta (META) fell 2.38% to $626.41 on Nov. 16, 2026, slightly less than the Nasdaq, as an Nvidia-led sell-off in AI-linked stocks hit Wall Street.
body_markdown:
## Why Meta Stock Fell


Financial media named no Meta-specific news behind Monday's drop.[24/7 Wall St.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/trump-media-sinks-12-ahead-170254192.html) listed Meta's decline alongside pressure on speculative and AI-linked stocks, with technology the weakest sector in a broadly lower market.


The sell-off was led by Nvidia. Per[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/15/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) , a source said Nvidia's board is not discussing bringing back Jensen Huang, who[resigned as CEO last week](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-16-2026/) , and the selling spread to AI-linked names such as Micron, Intel, AMD, Dell and Oracle. CNBC also listed information technology and communication services among the S&P 500's biggest decliners.


Policy added to the strain. As reported by[The Associated Press](https://www.bnnbloomberg.ca/markets/nasdaq/2026/11/16/stocks-decline-on-tech-sell-off-as-concerns-over-the-nvidia-fallout-persist/) , the Trump administration issued new rules on Monday restricting remote access to advanced US computing chips and servers, and AI-focused companies were by far the biggest weights on the market.


Separately,[FreightWaves](https://finance.yahoo.com/energy/articles/meta-pays-nevoya-put-25-220410952.html) reported after the close that Meta agreed to a multi-year deal to buy environmental attribute certificates tied to 25 electric trucks that Nevoya expects to run on Interstate 10 from 2027. Neither company disclosed the deal's value.


## META Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- According to Meta's[third-quarter 2026 results release](https://investor.atmeta.com/investor-news/press-release-details/2026/Meta-Reports-Third-Quarter-2026-Results/default.aspx) , revenue rose 26% year over year to $64.6 billion, and the company guided fourth-quarter revenue to $73 billion to $76 billion.
- Family daily active people averaged 3.64 billion in September 2026, up 3% year over year, per the same release.
- Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities stood at $82.45 billion as of September 30, 2026.


### Risks


- Meta narrowed its 2026 capital expenditure outlook to $135 billion to $145 billion, reported negative free cash flow of $2.12 billion for the third quarter and said it expects to keep investing aggressively in 2027.
- The company booked a $9.89 billion third-quarter charge tied to an agreement with 52 attorneys general over teen mental health and social media litigation, and its operating margin was 20%, against 40% a year earlier.
- The Associated Press reported that Democratic midterm wins had raised worries about possible restrictions on further AI data center construction, on top of the new chip remote-access rules.
